name: embrace_lying
desc: This scene lies on the floor, gravity points down. The pink goo crocodile lies on its back at the bottom, half sunk into a wide, glossy, sticky pink paint puddle on the floor along the bottom edge, its underside melting into the puddle with thick sticky goo. The pink goo Doberman lies on top, face down, embracing the crocodile chest to chest, and the small black witch cat is squashed and glued between their chests. Remove the vertical wall of goo on the right side: instead both monsters' lower bodies on the right melt, sag and pour down in thick dripping streams onto the floor puddle. Keep the heads on the left, the faces, the cat, the sizes, colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and pixel art style. Transparent background above the puddle.
